cases.selection_reason: 已确定目标。Luna历史存在INNER JOIN缩小全体英雄分母；另有独立投影遗漏，需把分母诊断与端到端EX分开记录。
题目和Evidence明确分母为女性患者；单表、无JOIN/去重/输出契约争议。所引用Sol历史双臂EX与Contract v2均正确，能检测范例是否误教所有分母=全表。
Evidence显式EUR人数/CZK人数；比率而非百分比，分母是CZK子集。Sol历史双臂正确且无其他已标注错因；同时守住不乘100与条件分母。
题意/Evidence/Gold为按标题取ViewCount，一列一行、无比例/日期/聚合/姓名列歧义；有独立Luna历史双臂正确标签，并在旧实验中列为正确对照。

model_visible_change.synthetic_domain: accounts/invoices; paid-account numerator and ALL-account denominator
model_visible_change.excludes: BIRD case IDs/questions/schema names/Gold SQL or numeric answers, offline reverse example, fixture rows/results

predeclared_development_gates.completeness: All 16 dispatched arms yield saved candidates and known EX/Contract/usage; no unknown, drift, retries or replaced samples.
predeclared_development_gates.target: md-259 Forge must move from EX=false and Contract=false in this control to EX=true and Contract=true in this treatment. Fixing denominator while omitting outputs does not pass; a correct control cannot establish this proposed repair signal.
predeclared_development_gates.controls: For md-079/md-000/md-312, any control-correct EX or Contract becoming treatment-incorrect fails. Inspect all eight pairs, including Direct stability; any Direct regression also blocks advancement. Historical Sol labels select controls, not expected current Luna scores.
predeclared_development_gates.p95_definition: nearest-rank of four Forge generation_ms values per condition; small-sample guard only, not a stable latency estimate
predeclared_development_gates.zero_correct_denominator: Undefined tokens-per-correct is reported as undefined and cannot pass the cost gate.
predeclared_development_gates.reporting: Keep complete four-case denominators, paired newly_passed/regressed, output omissions, denominator semantics, mis-rejection, unscored, per-arm tokens/latencies. Freeze gates before any tested model call.
predeclared_development_gates.decision: Passing is only a development signal for a separately approved R/H confirmation; no automatic adoption. Any unmet or inconclusive gate retains default and ends this budget without retry.

limitations: This example assumes a non-null primary-key population and enforced nullable foreign key; no arbitrary uniqueness or referential integrity is inferred for a real schema.
md-259 has separate denominator and output omission errors across different historical Luna candidates; do not combine them into one historical response.
Four exposed cases, single generation each, sequential conditions and historical mixed-model control labels cannot establish general accuracy or causal certainty.
Observed tokens are not a monetary quote; no real-provider usage or exact price is measured during preparation.

changes.behavior: Registered opt-in prompt revision; nondefault requires prompt factor. Freeze/HTTP/Pi bind it and compare permits only each manifest-bound prompt revision while keeping runtime/SDK and shared context fixed.
changes.deleted_test: Removed legacy structured-prompt wording assertions rather than re-pinning text.

Default prompt and optional context modes remain unchanged/off
No Gold, official snapshot, dataset, schema, compiler or Assurance changes
No historical scores or seed48 parent replacement
No additional semantic/repair/runtime architecture work or release/deployment
